title: Design System: PoseBoard project home and workspace

components.name: Project search
components.description: Labeled project-name field with the wrapper's visible keyboard focus.
components.html: <label class="ds-project-search">搜索项目<input placeholder="搜索项目名称" /></label>
components.css: .ds-project-search{font-size:0}.ds-project-search input{font-family:Inter,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;width:280px;height:40px;border:1px solid #dce3ec;border-radius:8px;padding:0 14px;font-size:14px;color:#182230;background:#f8fafc}.ds-project-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #246bfd;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-project-search{display:block}.ds-project-search input{width:100%}}

components.name: Import project
components.description: Visible upload-label focus follows the hidden native file input; no import handler is included in the preview.

components.name: Quick-start template
components.description: Text portion of the observed flat template button; real runtime cards also use the corresponding Phosphor task icon.
components.css: .ds-template-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;text-align:left;padding:20px;border:1px solid #dce3ec;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;color:#182230;cursor:pointer;font:14px Inter,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}.ds-template-card strong{font-size:16px}.ds-template-card span{font-size:14px;color:#64748b;line-height:1.6}.ds-template-card:hover{border-color:#246bfd}.ds-template-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #246bfd;outline-offset:3px}.ds-template-card:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-template-card{padding:14px}}

components.name: Project page switcher
components.description: Compact header selector that replaces the permanent page rail and returns its width to the editor.
components.html: <label class="ds-page-switcher">当前页面<select><option>舞台构图</option><option>分镜</option><option>动画时间轴</option></select></label>
components.css: .ds-page-switcher{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font:14px Inter,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;color:#64748b}.ds-page-switcher select{width:180px;height:32px;padding:0 28px 0 10px;color:#344054;background:#f8fafc;border:1px solid #dce3ec;border-radius:6px;text-overflow:ellipsis}.ds-page-switcher select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #246bfd;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-page-switcher select{width:min(34vw,140px)}}

components.name: Bottom recovery banner
components.description: Observed runtime alert positioning and recovery controls; preview controls have no persistence or export handlers.
components.html: 本地保存失败，请重试或导出项目
components.css: .ds-project-error{position:fixed;left:20px;right:20px;bottom:20px;max-height:45dvh;overflow:auto;z-index:3000;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;background:#fff1ef;border:1px solid #f4b4ab;padding:12px 16px;color:#912018;border-radius:8px;font:14px Inter,'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}.ds-project-error span{flex:1}.ds-project-error button{border:1px solid #e9a69b;border-radius:5px;padding:5px 8px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.ds-project-error button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #246bfd;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:720px){.ds-project-error{flex-wrap:wrap}}

narrative.overview: This additive, surface-scoped reference extends the incumbent Precision Light identity. It documents the project home and multi-page wrapper in `app/page.tsx` and `app/project-workspace.css`, not a replacement editor or a new brand. Root `DESIGN.md` remains authoritative for the retained studio; this file records only the wrapper's observed values and behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Flat white surfaces, cool-gray structure, and functional blue state.
Explicit project → page → shared-content hierarchy around the existing editor.
Compact controls, visible local-save status, and recoverable failures.
dos: Do preserve the incumbent editor and the project/page/shared-content hierarchy.
Do keep local-save language, wrapping recent names, visible upload focus and reachable recovery actions.
donts: Don't change the pinned Inter/blue-white identity or overwrite the root design reference.
Don't add unsupported cloud/account claims, catalog art, decorative motion or new accent systems.
